cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says a science or technology park is in service with tenants. The Royal Science and Technology Park runs an incubator programme (SWZ-012, SWZ-014) but awaited regulations for full operation in 2025 (SWZ-013), and no company tenants are named.
cells.note: Stage 4c 2026-11-15: Nhlangano iHub and Oracle Innovate Lab in Mbabane ran programmes in August 2026 (SWZ-001, SWZ-004), so 4 holds. The park's incubator took over 20 entrepreneurs in January 2026 (SWZ-012), but no tenants are on record, so not 5.
